findings.reason: the section's stated goal "keeping one facility-filter mechanism rather than two" is not met while a third domain_queries search keeps the join post-filter on an already-annotated index, so the plan must either include `find_code` or state why it is out of scope.
findings.text: §16 states the two indexes it unifies are "the same two" queried by domain_queries.py, but `find_code` queries `code_chunk_embedding` — the index §12 just registered `facility_id` on — and still post-filters facility via a `MATCH (cf:CodeFile) WHERE cf.id = ce.source_file` join (lines 465-476) instead of the property pre-filter §16 applies elsewhere

findings.reason: `_count_unembedded` has no caller anywhere in the tree today, so the divergence is latent and does not alter the retry behaviour the section delivers.
findings.text: §17 says `_fetch_unembedded` excludes `embed_failed_at IS NULL` "at both of its query sites", but the function has one such site (line 209); the second is in `_count_unembedded` (line 254), which the section does not change, so the fetch predicate and the count predicate would diverge

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — §17 adds a cutoff predicate inside the one shared label-parameterised embed worker rather than a parallel retry path, and §16 changes the facility predicate inside the one shared `build_vector_search` caller set, so complexity stays behind the existing interface.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — §16's inventory of `domain_queries.py` searches is incomplete: `find_code` (imas_codex/graph/domain_queries.py:458) queries the `code_chunk_embedding` index §12 just annotated, but retains a CodeFile-join post-filter rather than the `facility_id` pre-filter §16 unifies.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; §16 and §17 each state "Interface budget: nothing added" and name what they retire (the over-fetch and the manual-clear docstring), and §9/§14 touch none of the four families (§14 reuses `discover paths --root`, which already exists at imas_codex/cli/discover/paths.py:20).
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — every implementable section extends a named existing owner (§17 `imas_codex/discovery/base/embed_worker.py` and `reset.py`, §16 the §12 in-index facility annotation over `build_vector_search`, §9 the existing `probe_remote_environment` and DataAccess writers, §14 the existing `discover paths --root` scope), and I confirmed each exists on disk.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — no section introduces a layer over existing machinery without justifying extension; §9 extracts one `MERGE ... DataAccess` statement into `persist_data_access` with two callers, which removes duplication rather than adding surface.
